title: Spikers' Turf: ClearSkiiin fends off Cabstars to stay unbeaten
summary: ClearSkiiin battled to its second win in a row in the 2026 Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Wednesday, overcoming AEP-Cabstars in a four-set affair at the Filoil EcoOil Centre.
